roadmapTask: Horizon 11 of FeatureSync: in-browser flag editing in the local dashboard — operators edit a feature's enabled flag and a config feature's default value instead of pasting a whole snapshot JSON; each edit publishes a new snapshot version via S3SnapshotPublisher with a compare-and-swap on the expected current version. Production-ready, 100% coverage.
